39/S0.subgoal: Describe the three broad categories of interaction techniques in immersive environments.

39/S1.subgoal: Identify the key parameters that influence the suitability of different object selection techniques.

39/S2.subgoal: Describe the various categories of selection techniques and explain hand selection techniques in detail.

39/S3.subgoal: Describe intent-driven selection using proximity spheres and hand postures.

39/S4.subgoal: Describe pointing-based selection techniques using different body parts and input devices.

39/S5.subgoal: Explain improvements to basic ray casting techniques, including bend cast and depth ray techniques.

39/S6.subgoal: Describe image plane selection techniques for 2D virtual environments.

39/S7.subgoal: Describe volumetric selection techniques for 3D virtual environments.

39/S8.subgoal: Describe object manipulation and the most intuitive hand manipulation technique.

39/S9.subgoal: Explain the use of 3D widgets as an indirect manipulation technique.

39/S10.subgoal: Explain various indirect proxy techniques for manipulation, including local proxies and world in miniature.

39/S11.subgoal: Describe bimanual manipulation techniques including spindle and spindle plus wheel.

39/S12.subgoal: Explain integrated hybrid manipulation techniques like HOMER.

39/S13.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
